task_description: Create a complete movie booking system with Node.js backend (zero external dependencies) and mobile-first frontend UI with purple theme, 5-tab bottom navigation (Home, Cinemas, Food Order, My Tickets, Account), matching the user's mobile app design specifications.

verification.summary: Server starts and serves all API endpoints correctly with write lock protection. Frontend is 97KB single-file SPA with all 5 screens, purple theme, mobile-first design, XSS protection via escapeHTML(). Full booking flow works end-to-end with seat locking. All review issues from v1 and v2 addressed.
